name: MNC
recent: M N C Wireless 于 2026 年 11 月 12 日召开特别股东大会，股东通过削减最多 RM83.00 million 已发行股本的特别决议。公司于 10 月 29 日签署谅解备忘录，并公布截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日止季度业绩，营收环比和同比均下降。
notable: 股东在特别股东大会通过削减最多 RM83.00 million 已发行股本的特别决议。
公司于 2026 年 10 月 29 日签署谅解备忘录。
公司公布截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日止季度业绩，营收环比下降 33.8%，同比下降 49.3%。
risks: 公司净亏损 RM174,000，净利率为 -5.9%，仍处于亏损状态。
营收环比下降 33.8%，同比下降 49.3%。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日止季度，营收为 RM2,951,000，环比下降 33.8%，同比下降 49.3%；净亏损 RM174,000，净利率 -5.9%，较上一季度的 -38.3% 有所收窄。

recent_en: M N C Wireless held an EGM on 12 November 2026 where shareholders approved a special resolution to reduce up to RM83.00 million of issued share capital. The company signed a memorandum of understanding on 29 October and announced quarterly results for the period ended 31 August 2026, with revenue declining both QoQ and YoY.
notable_en: Shareholders approved a special resolution to reduce up to RM83.00 million of issued share capital at the EGM.
The company signed a memorandum of understanding on 29 October 2026.
The company announced quarterly results for the period ended 31 August 2026, with revenue down 33.8% QoQ and 49.3% YoY.
risks_en: The company recorded a net loss of RM174,000 with a net margin of -5.9%, remaining in loss.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 August 2026, revenue was RM2,951,000, down 33.8% QoQ and 49.3% YoY; net loss was RM174,000 with a net margin of -5.9%, improved from -38.3% in the previous quarter.
